title: Register stores a visible consent timestamp
summary: Creating a public account now requires a visible tick that you accept the terms of use and privacy notice. MyAPES Core stores the time of that consent on the account.
changes: Show a required consent checkbox on public register, with links to the terms of use and privacy notice.
Refuse registration until consent is given, and store the consent timestamp on the public local account.
version_rationale: Patch release: adds the missing register consent tick and stored timestamp without changing sign-in, roles, or existing accounts.
validation: PHPUnit PublicAccountLifecycleTest covers the required consent control, rejected submit without consent, and the stored registration timestamp.

PHPUnit PublicLegalPagesTest, AccountLifecycleSchemaTest, AuthorizationAuthenticationTest, and RolelessApplicationCompatibilityTest cover register legal links, the nullable consent column, and existing registration paths.
php artisan myapes:changelog-validate --base-ref=origin/main on the PR branch.
known_limitations: Accounts created before this release do not receive a backfilled consent timestamp.
rollback: Redeploy the previous application version to remove the required register consent tick and stop storing a new consent timestamp.
provenance: Register consent timestamp for issue #124, pull request #205.
